name: plan_sql
description: Generate a structured SQL query plan from natural language. Returns a QueryPlan with tables, fields, filters, and aggregations instead of raw SQL. This allows for value normalization and RBAC enforcement.

question.description: Natural language question to plan a query for

candidate_schema.description: Optional pre-selected schema (from search_schema). If not provided, will search automatically.

return_type.description: Structured QueryPlan with tables, select_fields, filters, joins, group_by, order_by, and limit

input.question: Show total revenue by country for last 3 months

examples.description: Generate a query plan for revenue aggregation

safety_guidelines: Returns structured plan, not executable SQL
Use query_sql_from_plan to execute the plan
Plan should be validated before execution
